pairs: In dedication to the house of David.
nec delectasti inimicos meos super me.
and you have not allowed my enemies to delight over me.
I have cried out to you,
you led my soul away from Hell.
salvasti me a descendentibus in lacum.
You have saved me from those who descend into the pit.
Sing a psalm to the Lord,
and confess with remembrance of his holiness.
For wrath is in his indignation,
and life is in his will.
Ego autem dixi in abundantia mea:
But I have said in my abundance:
in voluntate tua præstitisti decori meo virtutem;
in your will, you made virtue preferable to beauty for me.
You turned your face away from me,
And I will make supplication to my God.
What use would there be in my blood,
and he has been merciful to me.
The Lord has become my helper.
Convertisti planctum meum in gaudium mihi;
You have turned my mourning into gladness for me.
You have cut off my sackcloth,
and you have surrounded me with joy.
So then, may my glory sing to you,
and may I not regret it.
I will confess to you for eternity.
